snippet.title: YARG Setlist: Thousand Thoughts, Luminism, and more
snippet.description:
Wave 5 is here! Check out 5 new songs featuring Thousand Thoughts, Inflicted, Shibito, Parasiticide, and luminism available now through the launcher! Just download/update the setlist and the songs will automatically be included in your library when you launch YARG.

If you're a developer, artist, or band and are interested in contributing to YARG, feel free to join us on Discord, GitHub, or contact us via our email. We are 100% open source and always welcome anyone who wants to contribute!

Interested in getting your music added to the official YARG setlist or a DLC pack? Reach out to yargchartingteam@gmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Featured Songs:
"Voidwalker" by Inflicted https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eM2rfOxBBcE
"Allure" by Shibito https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jve5CExJXt0
"Poser" by Luminism https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kt9VtwRlm3A
"Bathe in Blood" by Parasiticide https://parasiticide.bandcamp.com/track/002-bathe-in-blood
"Circles" by Thousand Thoughts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u6HSOz5ptTc
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Website and Download: https://yarg.in/
Discord: https://discord.gg/sqpu4R552r
GitHub: https://github.com/YARC-Official/YARG
